articles.title: Dianna Russini marks return to social media by taking advantage of NFL Trade Deadline with first post since Mike Vrabel scandal
articles.standfirst: Russini hadn't posted on her X account since April, and she's now promoting her new show.
articles.summary: Russini hadn't posted on her X account since April, and she's now promoting her new show.
articles.body:
In the aftermath of the Dianna Russini and Mike Vrabel scandal, it was clear that the New England Patriots head coach was somewhat in the clear; at least professionally. Russini is the one who suffered the most, as she was fired from The Athletic and her journalistic career was in jeopardy.

But over the past couple of weeks, rumors began circulating that Russini was working on a big comeback. That was confirmed this week, as " The Russini Report " has been announced. It's a new weekly show featuring Russini that will cover NFL topics. It's set to premier on Wednesday, November 12 on BetUS TV .

Now that she's back in the media fold, Russini is taking advantage of her reporting connections and the timely NFL Trade Deadline to resurrect her social media career . In her first post on X since April 2 , Russini dropped some " What I'm Hearing " insider knowledge.

Dianna Russini returns to X with first post since April 2

Russini reports that the Minnesota Vikings are calling around the league for available quarterbacks. They even tried to poach Mac Jones from the San Francisco 49ers , but they're asking for too much at the moment. She also echoed Adam Schefter 's report that Kirk Cousins is still Minnesota's top option.

She also made sure to promote her new show in a follow-up post. The premiere episode will feature special guests Bill Parcells , Damon Amendolara , and Spike Eskin .

Fans didn't exactly take too kindly to Russini's first X post in seven months. They won't let her live down the Vrabel scandal.

articles.title: “$12,000 in rent and now rats?”: Shilo Sanders slams life in New York following disgusting encounters in restaurants
articles.standfirst: Deion Sanders' son has discovered another drawback to his potential move to the Big Apple
articles.summary: Deion Sanders' son has discovered another drawback to his potential move to the Big Apple
articles.body:
S hilo Sanders is finding that life in New York might not be quite as appealing as he initially imagined.

The former Colorado Buffaloes safety has been enjoying his time in the city, but a series of unpleasant encounters has left him questioning whether he could actually make it his home.

His latest complaint has nothing to do with basketball, football or the city's famously expensive apartments.

Instead, Sanders says rats have become an increasingly uncomfortable part of his experience, including an encounter inside a restaurant that reportedly sent him rushing outside.

In an Instagram Reel posted on November 9, the son of Colorado head coach Deion Sanders explained why the situation was becoming difficult to tolerate.

“I love New York. I’ve had a great time out here, but every place I go into, it’s rats, bro,” Shilo said. “I can’t do this. I promise you, I’ve seen three rats out here since I’ve been here. I can’t live like that, bro.”

The video then captured another moment after Sanders apparently left a restaurant because he spotted a rat inside. Someone subsequently informed him that the animal had been caught, prompting a relieved response.

“Oh, you got it? Oh, all right, they got it, bro,” Shilo said. “I had to run out of here. I can’t do this, bro.”

His reaction was another indication that the city might not be winning him over, particularly after his earlier concerns about the cost of finding somewhere comfortable to live.

The $12,000 apartment problem is still hanging over his decision

Sanders had previously discussed the possibility of relocating to New York during a house-hunting conversation in Florida. He initially appeared enthusiastic about exploring the market, even suggesting that he would film the search.

“I’m actually going to go out there and do a house hunt video there ’cause I’m trying to look in New York. Should I move there?” he asked.

However, the reality of the city's property prices quickly became a concern. In an earlier video, Sanders questioned how much living space renters actually receive for the money they spend.

“My biggest thing about New York, bro, is the square footage for the price,” Shilo said. “I don’t know who normalized the real estate market in New York, but it’s outrageous, bro.”

He suggested that even a monthly budget of $12,000 might not secure the type of apartment he wanted. That figure is far above the city's typical rental prices, but it highlights the level of luxury Sanders appears to be considering.

The wider market offers little encouragement. Realtor.com's October 27 rental report found that New York City's median asking rent reached $3,785 in the third quarter of 2026, a 4.5% increase compared with the same period last year. Manhattan was considerably more expensive, with a median of $5,375, while Brooklyn reached $4,197.

Sanders has also explored properties in Florida, including expensive rentals in Miami and Fort Lauderdale.

One downtown Miami property reportedly caught his attention because of its river views, but its $14,000 monthly price was too much for him. His brother, Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders, even offered to help with a down payment on a house.

New York's rat problem, meanwhile, has become a familiar part of the city's reputation. There has been some progress: the Department of Sanitation reported that 311 rat-sighting complaints fell from 25,230 between December 2023 and November 2024 to 20,025 during the following 12 months, a 20.6% decrease. The city has attributed the improvement in part to requirements for buildings and businesses to store rubbish in sealed containers.

Still, Sanders ' personal experience appears to have made a strong impression.

“I was gonna go house hunting, all that stuff, but I don’t know, bro. This ain’t my type of place,” Shilo concluded in the reel.

For now, the former college football player has not ruled out spending more time in New York, but finding an apartment he likes may not be enough.

After the expensive property search and the restaurant encounters, Sanders has another question to answer: whether the lifestyle is worth the price.

articles.title: Miami Ohio gets one of the strangest penalties in college football after wild scoreboard stunt
articles.summary: Miami University of Ohio received an unusual unsportsmanlike conduct penalty during its November 10, 2026, college football game against Ohio University at Yager Stadium in Oxford, Ohio. Stadium video board operators displayed images of additional yellow goalposts behind the actual uprights while the visiting team's kicker prepared for a field goal.
articles.body:
Miami University of Ohio received an unusual unsportsmanlike conduct penalty during its November 10, 2026, college football game against Ohio University at Yager Stadium in Oxford, Ohio. Stadium video board operators displayed images of additional yellow goalposts behind the actual uprights while the visiting team's kicker prepared for a field goal.

With Ohio leading 17-7 late in the first half, kicker Brack Peacock attempted a 34-yard field goal. The ball struck the upright and missed, but officials penalized Miami for the distracting scoreboard display. The penalty moved Ohio closer to the end zone and awarded an automatic first down.

Instead of attempting another field goal, Ohio tried a fake kick. Holder Magnus Haines threw a pass toward Evan Herrman in the end zone, but it fell incomplete as the half expired. The unusual penalty therefore did not produce any additional points for Ohio.

Miami ultimately won 34-17 after scoring 27 unanswered points in the second half. NCAA rules prohibit video board operators from creating distractions that interfere with play, a restriction expanded following a similar incident involving Oklahoma State in 2020. The bizarre call quickly went viral across college football social media.

articles.title: Nine years after the death of a Playboy model, a legal battle puts Shawne Merriman back in the spotlight
articles.standfirst: Kimberly Fattorini's parents are seeking to preserve a $4 million settlement and submitted text messages from the night their daughter died to defend their position in court.
articles.summary: Kimberly Fattorini's parents are seeking to preserve a $4 million settlement and submitted text messages from the night their daughter died to defend their position in court.
articles.body:
The death of Kimberly Fattorini, a model linked to Playboy who died in 2017 at the age of 30, is once again at the center of a legal dispute in the United States.

Nine years after what happened, the case once again involves former NFL player Shawne Merriman , who was found liable along with three other people in a wrongful death lawsuit.

The new battle revolves around a $4 million compensation . Kimberly's parents want to prevent the judgment from being reduced and, to support their position, they submitted documents that include alleged text messages exchanged during the night of the young woman's death.

The messages from the night Kimberly Fattorini died

According to court documents obtained by TMZ, the family submitted conversations attributed to Elias Wehbe, a former nightclub promoter linked to the case. Among the messages mentioned is an invitation to Wehbe's house to use cocaine, colloquially identified as "blow".

The parents also contend that Wehbe was aware of a message in which Kimberly warned that a friend had put GHB in her drink. According to the filing, he later allegedly saw the young woman, in an intoxicated state, leave in an Uber with Merriman.

Kimberly died on July 21, 2017, after a night of partying in Los Angeles. The autopsy determined that she died from an accidental overdose and found alcohol, cocaine, and GHB in her system. This latter substance has a very narrow safety margin, so even a minimal variation in the dose can induce a coma or respiratory arrest. Her parents filed a wrongful death lawsuit in 2019 to seek accountability for the circumstances surrounding her death.

In 2025, a jury found Merriman, Wehbe, and two other people liable . Subsequently, a judge formalized a joint judgment of $4 million in favor of Kimberly's parents. Now, Wehbe is seeking to reduce that amount, while the family has presented new arguments to preserve the compensation.

Shawne Merriman denied any wrongdoing

During the process, Kimberly's parents maintained that their daughter may have been drugged and may also have suffered a sexual assault. However, these claims are part of the family's allegations and should not be confused with a criminal conviction. The death was officially classified as accidental, and no criminal charges were filed against Merriman .

The former San Diego Chargers player denied having engaged in any wrongdoing. His representative also rejected the allegations and maintained that the police investigation had found no irregularities attributable to Merriman. As the dispute over the 4 million dollars continues, the new documents once again put the messages and the circumstances of that 2017 night under scrutiny.

Currently, Shawne Merriman is retired from professional activity after ending his NFL career in 2013, following eight seasons in which he shined as a defensive star for the San Diego Chargers and had a brief final stint with the Buffalo Bills.

Far from the gridiron, the 42-year-old former linebacker remains connected to the sports world as a television analyst and entrepreneur, leading his own mixed martial arts promotion, Lights Out Xtreme Fighting, while also managing his personal clothing brand and projects on streaming platforms.

articles.title: “She has some of the best relationships in the business”: Why the NFL is backing Dianna Russini’s return after the Mike Vrabel scandal
articles.standfirst: Dianna Russini is back covering football with a new weekly show
articles.summary: Dianna Russini is back covering football with a new weekly show
articles.body:
Dianna Russini ’s return to NFL coverage is already attracting attention, not only because of the Mike Vrabel controversy that forced her departure from The Athletic, but also because of the support she appears to have maintained among people in professional football.

According to sources cited by TMZ, Russini has received considerable encouragement from the NFL community since launching her new project, The Russini Report.

Those familiar with the situation reportedly believe that her relationships across the sport remain strong, with players, coaches and other influential figures willing to work with her again.

One source told TMZ: “She has some of the best relationships in the business, and there’s real excitement about giving fans one more place to talk football and hear what’s happening around the league.”

That backing could prove important as the veteran reporter attempts to rebuild her professional standing after several months away from the spotlight.

Russini announced her new role with BetUS on November 9. The project includes a weekly live program and a regular column covering NFL developments, matchups and news from around the league.

Explaining her enthusiasm for returning, Russini said: “Football has always been my favorite sport to cover, and I’ve really missed being in the middle of the action, breaking stories and connecting fans to what’s happening across the league.”

Her new venture represents her first major media assignment since resigning from The Athletic in April.

The controversy that changed Russini’s career

Russini's departure followed the publication of photographs showing her with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel at an Arizona resort. The images prompted widespread speculation about the nature of their relationship, with both individuals married to other people.

Russini and Vrabel denied allegations of an affair, and the photographs alone did not establish that a romantic relationship existed.

However, The Athletic subsequently conducted an internal investigation into Russini's work and her connection with the Patriots coach.

The findings, published in September, concluded that the relationship violated the outlet's editorial standards because it had not been disclosed appropriately. The investigation did not determine whether the relationship was romantic.

The fallout nevertheless became a major professional setback for Russini , who had previously established herself as a prominent NFL insider through her work at ESPN and The Athletic.

Her return also comes with questions about whether she will receive the same level of access to teams, players and coaches that helped make her reporting influential.

Although TMZ's sources describe a welcoming atmosphere within the league, the NFL has not publicly confirmed the extent of its institutional support or clarified her credential status for major events.

That distinction matters because personal relationships within football and formal access granted by the league are not necessarily the same thing.

A new platform, but questions remain

Russini's new show premiered on November 11, although its scheduled noon ET launch was delayed by technical problems. The program eventually became available after the BetUS website experienced difficulties, reportedly because of heavy traffic.

The first episode featured football discussion and guests including former NFL coach Bill Parcells . Russini did not directly address the Vrabel controversy during the broadcast, instead reflecting on the time she had spent away from her career and with her family.

Her partnership with BetUS also represents a different professional environment from her previous positions at major sports-media organizations.

The company is an offshore sportsbook, and its regulatory standing has attracted scrutiny in the United States.

For Russini , however, the immediate priority appears to be returning to the sport she has covered for more than a decade. The reported encouragement from people around the NFL could help her regain access and rebuild an audience.

Still, the real test will come through the quality of her reporting, the sources willing to speak with her and whether her new platform can establish credibility over time. Her comeback is underway, but the questions surrounding her departure have not entirely disappeared.

articles.title: What NFL teams have a bye in Week 10? Everyone who's out this week
articles.standfirst: Four teams will sit out the NFL's Week 10 schedule, giving their players a chance to recover while the rest of the league continues its push toward the postseason
articles.summary: Four teams will sit out the NFL's Week 10 schedule, giving their players a chance to recover while the rest of the league continues its push toward the postseason
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL regular season is moving into its second half, and Week 10 brings a scheduled break for four franchises.

The Chicago Bears , Denver Broncos , Philadelphia Eagles and Tampa Bay Buccaneers will not play this weekend, leaving 28 teams in action across the latest round of games.

The bye-week arrangement means supporters of those four teams will have to wait until the following weekend to see their clubs return to the field.

It also creates an opportunity for players to recover from the physical demands of the opening nine weeks, while coaching staffs can review performances and prepare for the remaining schedule.

According to the NFL's official 2026 bye-week calendar, all four teams are scheduled to have their break in Week 10, which runs from November 12 through November 16.

The four teams with a Week 10 bye are:

The break arrives at different points in the season for each franchise, with some enjoying a strong start and others needing time to regroup before the second half of the campaign.

How the bye week affects each team

The Denver Broncos enter their week off in particularly encouraging circumstances. They defeated the Carolina Panthers 26-21 in Week 9, taking their record to 7-2 and keeping themselves at the top of the AFC West. The victory also left Denver tied for the most wins in the NFL.

Quarterback Bo Nix has helped guide the team through a demanding opening stretch, and the break offers the Broncos an opportunity to recover before returning to the field.

Nix described the team's position as positive, saying: "We're in a really good spot, obviously where you want to be." Denver will hope to preserve that momentum when its schedule resumes.

The Chicago Bears also enter the bye with a 7-2 record. Their most recent outing was a 27-24 victory over the Buccaneers on November 8, a result that strengthened their position in the NFC.

The extra week should give Chicago's coaching staff time to assess what has worked during its impressive start and address any weaknesses before the next challenge.

Philadelphia, meanwhile, has a very different situation to consider. The Eagles are 2-7 after losing 19-11 to the New York Giants in Week 9. Their break provides some breathing room for a team that needs to find answers after a difficult opening to the season.

Tampa Bay is also looking for a reset. The Buccaneers fell 27-24 to Chicago in their latest game and enter the bye with a 3-6 record. The defeat extended their difficult run, making the additional preparation time potentially valuable as they attempt to improve their position.

What does Week 10 look like for the rest of the NFL?

Although four teams are absent, the Week 10 schedule still features plenty of important matchups.

Thursday Night Football opens the round with the Washington Commanders visiting the New York Giants on November 12. Sunday's schedule includes the international matchup between the New England Patriots and Detroit Lions in Munich, followed by games involving the Kansas City Chiefs, Atlanta Falcons, Houston Texans, Cleveland Browns, Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay Packers .

The remaining schedule also includes the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday night, while the Los Angeles Chargers visit the Baltimore Ravens on Monday night.

For fantasy football managers, the four bye teams mean several players will be unavailable for Week 10 lineups.

Anyone relying on key Bears, Broncos, Eagles or Buccaneers players will need to make alternative arrangements, particularly if they have limited depth at running back, wide receiver or quarterback.

The NFL's bye weeks continue beyond this round. Six teams are scheduled to sit out Week 11, making that the busiest break of the season, while no teams have a bye in Week 12.

For now, Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are the four franchises with a weekend off. Their next appearances will come after the scheduled pause, with the hope that the rest will help them finish the season strongly.

articles.body:
The 2026 - 2027 NFL season reaches its Week 10 with the pecking order already clearly defined, but with several matchups that could shake up the playoff picture. While the 49ers and the Bills set the pace at the top of their conferences, the slate dishes out heavyweight matchups on both sides.

Dallas, meanwhile, lives off its offensive firepower: its 246 points scored are the most in the entire NFC, but the 236 points allowed explain its losing record. If the 49ers impose their pace, they can quiet AT&T Stadium; if Dallas turns the game into a shootout, things get tight.

The slate has playoff implications everywhere. In the NFC, San Francisco (7-1) leads the conference just ahead of the Chicago Bears (7-2), so a win in Dallas would cement its advantage.

For either of these teams, each additional loss brings mathematically saying goodbye to January closer.

Prediction for the most important games of Week 10

In the marquee matchup, San Francisco's defensive solidity and control of the ground game should carry more weight than the home team's firepower: 49ers by the slimmest of margins in Dallas, in a game with points to spare.

On Monday Night, the 6-2 tie between Pittsburgh and Cincinnati promises a close finish, with a slight edge for the Bengals at home thanks to their offensive firepower. And in New York, the Bills start as clear favorites against a Jets team that has not found its footing.

Week 10 will not define the season, but it will say a lot about who is carrying momentum into the decisive stretch.

articles.title: Here are the alleged text messages from the day Playboy model Kimberly Fattorini died, involving former NFL star Shawne Merriman
articles.standfirst: Fattorini was found dead in July 2017
articles.summary: Fattorini was found dead in July 2017
articles.body:
The final hours of Kimberly Fattorini ’s life have come under renewed scrutiny after court documents revealed alleged text messages involving the former NFL linebacker Shawne Merriman and nightclub promoter Elias Wehbe . The exchange reportedly took place on July 21, 2017, the day the model died and TMZ reported that the messages were included in court filings submitted by Fattorini ’s parents, who are challenging Wehbe’s effort to reduce a $4 million wrongful death judgment.

The texts appear to show Wehbe discussing Fattorini and two other women while they were at his home and in one alleged message, as he told the former athlete he had three “whores” at his property, naming Kimberly and two others as Merriman then wrote: “Nah I'm tryna get rid of them so I can smash.” The exchange reportedly continued with complaints that the women would not leave and Wehbe allegedly asked Merriman to arrange for another man to text Fattorini , while also suggesting that somebody was becoming jealous. The messages form part of the family’s argument that Wehbe helped arrange for their intoxicated daughter to leave his home with Merriman that night. The filings add detail to a civil case that has continued for years following Fattorini’ s death. Her parents sued Merriman and others in 2019, alleging she had been drugged before suffering a fatal overdose.

Her death was ultimately ruled accidental, with alcohol, cocaine and GHB found in her system. Fattorini was 30 when she died on July 21, 2017 after being found unresponsive at an apartment in West Hollywood, California . She had worked as a model and in entertainment, including as a casting associate, and had credits connected to Playboy , television productions and independent film projects. The case remains a civil matter, and the jury’s liability finding should not be confused with a criminal conviction. Merriman has denied wrongdoing, whilst Fattorini ’s parents continue to contest the attempt to reduce the judgment as they point to the alleged messages from the day she died.

What the lawsuit alleges about Fattorini’s final hours

The family’s case centered on the circumstances surrounding Fattorini ’s movements and condition before she died as the newly highlighted messages are being cited by her parents as support for the jury’s findings. Although the excerpts alone do not establish every detail of what happened that night, a jury found Merriman and three other defendants liable in the civil proceedings in 2025, and a judge entered the four million judgment in October 2026. Merriman has denied wrongdoing, and the current dispute includes efforts to reduce the award, which Fattorini’s parents are opposing. The 42-year-old was a prominent linebacker known as Lights Out . The San Diego Chargers selected him 12th overall in the 2005 draft, and he won Defensive Rookie of the Year before earning three consecutive Pro Bowl selections. He later played for the Buffalo Bills and retired in 2013 and his career included a standout 2006 season, when he recorded 17 sacks and earned First-Team All-Pro recognition. After leaving football, Merriman founded the mixed martial arts promotion Lights Out Xtreme Fighting .

articles.title: Rex Ryan faces hit-and-run allegations as Nashville victim breaks silence
articles.standfirst: The allegations have added another layer of controversy to the incident involving the former NFL coach
articles.summary: The allegations have added another layer of controversy to the incident involving the former NFL coach
articles.body:
Former NFL head coach and ESPN analyst Rex Ryan is facing serious allegations following an alleged hit-and-run incident in Nashville, Tennessee. One of the two people who claims to have been struck by Ryan’s pickup truck is now speaking publicly, accusing the former New York Jets coach of leaving the scene without offering an apology or checking on the victims.

Attorney Michael Holland told the California Post that he and his wife were crossing the street at a crosswalk last week when they were allegedly hit by Ryan’s vehicle . According to Holland, the incident could have resulted in much more serious injuries. “If we had been six inches further out, I’d be in a hospital right now and so would my wife,” Holland said.

The attorney also described the vehicle as weighing more than 6,000 pounds and alleged that Ryan failed to pay attention while making a turn, striking both pedestrians. “He decided he wanted to turn and didn’t care and just ran over both of my feet, my wife’s foot and got her leg too,” Holland told the publication.

The allegations have added another layer of controversy to the incident involving the former NFL coach , who has since surrendered to Nashville police.

Rex Ryan allegedly left the scene after hitting the couple

According to Holland’s account, the incident did not end when the couple was struck by the pickup truck. The attorney claimed that Ryan continued driving before Holland managed to catch up with him and began pounding on the vehicle’s window to get his attention.

Holland said the driver eventually got out of the truck and was informed about what had happened. However, the attorney alleged that Ryan showed little concern for the couple and left without apologizing or remaining at the scene.

“He was told in no uncertain terms what he had done, and instead of staying at the scene or even saying, ‘Sorry,’ he just got back in his vehicle and took off,” Holland claimed. The account raises questions about the circumstances surrounding the alleged collision and the decision to leave before police could fully investigate the incident.

According to a warrant obtained by TMZ , authorities were able to match the vehicle’s license plate to Ryan’s identification, helping investigators establish a connection between the former coach and the alleged hit-and-run. Ryan subsequently surrendered to the Nashville Metropolitan Police Department this week.

Rex Ryan surrenders to Nashville police

The surrender represents a significant development in the investigation involving the former NFL coach. Ryan , who became one of the most recognizable personalities in professional football through his coaching career and television appearances, is now facing public scrutiny over the allegations.

The incident is particularly notable given his prominent position as an ESPN analyst and his previous career in the NFL. However, the allegations made by Holland should be distinguished from any findings that might emerge through the legal process. The former coach’s surrender does not, by itself, establish guilt or confirm every detail of the attorney’s account.

Additional information about the investigation, including the precise circumstances of the collision and the extent of the couple’s injuries, will be important in determining what happened.

From NFL sidelines to another controversy

Ryan is best known for his time as head coach of the New York Jets, whom he led to consecutive AFC Championship Game appearances following the 2009 and 2010 seasons.

His outspoken personality, defensive expertise and colorful press conferences made him one of the NFL’s most recognizable coaches during that period.

After his departure from the Jets, Ryan also coached the Buffalo Bills before transitioning into television, where he became a familiar face on ESPN’s football programming . Now, the allegations surrounding the Nashville incident have shifted attention away from his football career.

articles.title: “Unfair advantage”: Outrage in the NFL after the FAA’s historic flight suspension forced a change in Week 10 referees
articles.standfirst: FAA travel chaos forces NFL into unusual officiating shake-up
articles.summary: FAA travel chaos forces NFL into unusual officiating shake-up
articles.body:
The NFL's Week 10 preparations have taken an unexpected turn, with a nationwide aviation disruption forcing the league to reshuffle its officiating assignments.

However, the decision to send replacement referees to games within driving distance of their hometowns has sparked concerns among fans about potential home-team favoritism.

The controversy follows the event of Friday, when the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) imposed a nationwide flight suspension after a telecommunications failure disrupted air traffic control operations.

Although the restriction was lifted later that evening, the disruption caused widespread cancellations and delays, leaving airlines struggling to restore normal services into Saturday.

With NFL officials relying on commercial flights rather than private team charters, getting every officiating crew to its originally assigned destination became difficult. The league therefore introduced emergency changes to ensure Sunday's games could proceed as planned without further travel complications.

According to the NFL, each of its 17 officiating crews has a designated backup referee who receives training throughout the season to step into the position when necessary. This preparation allowed the league to respond to the unexpected disruption without having to postpone its scheduled matchups.

Three backup officials given major Week 10 responsibilities

The emergency arrangements will see three officials assume referee responsibilities across four matchups. Umpire Duane Heydt will oversee Carolina's meeting with New Orleans, while fellow umpire Barry Anderson has been assigned Jacksonville's clash against Tennessee.

Side judge Don Willard faces an especially unusual schedule, having been appointed referee for both Miami against Indianapolis and Pittsburgh against Cincinnati.

Willard will first oversee Sunday's 1 p.m. ET contest between the Dolphins and Colts in Indianapolis. He'll then travel approximately 109 miles to Cincinnati to take charge of the Steelers-Bengals matchup, scheduled for 8:20 p.m. ET.

The double assignment creates an unusual situation, particularly because Willard's regular crew, led by referee Scott Novak , wasn't originally scheduled to work this weekend. The NFL hasn't publicly revealed every adjustment involving the other established officiating crews.

Nevertheless, the changes have divided fans, with several questioning whether assigning officials near their hometowns creates complications.

“Home field advantage! Get your bets in people,” wrote one fan.

“That’s a good conflict of interest. Glad they got a full weeks worth of lawyering before they can drive to the game and let their friends and family cheer them on as they favour their home team,” wrote another.

Still, the NFL's priority appears to be keeping Sunday's schedule intact despite the travel disruption. Unlike officials, teams generally use private charter aircraft, allowing them to continue their journeys with fewer complications.

Whether the reassignment concerns translate into controversy on the field remains to be seen.

articles.title: Who is Don Willard, the referee who will officiate the Dolphins vs. Colts game that same day and then drive 110 miles to Cincinnati for the Steelers vs. Bengals game?
articles.standfirst: Willard finds himself in a unique situation after chaos with the Federal Aviation Administration
articles.summary: Willard finds himself in a unique situation after chaos with the Federal Aviation Administration
articles.body:
Don Willard is scheduled to referee two games on the same Sunday, with a 110-mile drive between them as the nine-year veteran will oversee the Miami Dolphins and Indianapolis Colts matchup before heading to Cincinnati for the Pittsburgh Steelers vs the Bengals .

Willard 's first assignment is at 13:00 ET/10:00 PT in Indiana , where the Dolphins visit the Lucas Oil Stadium and once that game is complete, he and several members of his crew are expected to hop over to Ohio , arriving to take charge of the Bengals ' meeting with the Steelers at 20:20 ET/17:20 PT.

The NFL confirmed the changes on Saturday after a nationwide flight ground stop disrupted travel plans, meaning Willard will work alongside umpire Terry Killens , field judge Jabir Walker and side judge Justin Larrew , with the group covering both contests rather than the two originally scheduled crews.

Willard has spent nine years officiating in the NFL and has also worked six playoff games but he usually operates as a side judge on Scott Novak 's crew, so meaning Sunday's assignment represents a significant change in responsibility as well as an extraordinary workload.

The league said each of its 17 officiating crews has a designated backup referee who trains throughout the year to step into that role when required, and Willard is among the officials being moved into the position after travel disruption left the NFL needing replacements who could reach games by road.

What caused the Federal Aviation Administration to ground flights across the United States?

The disruption began on Friday, November 13, when a failure in the FAA 's air traffic control communications network forced a nationwide halt to departures as officials said the incident was not a cyberattack, but stemmed from a routine technology upgrade that overwhelmed parts of the system.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said contractor L3Harris was replacing ageing copper telephone lines with fiber-optic connections at a remote site but a router involved in the work began sending excessive connection requests to other equipment, creating problems for controller communications and radar feeds.

articles.title: The unexpected star of LSU's loss: its mascot tried to get into a fight with a Texas player
articles.standfirst: Mike the Tiger had to be restrained by staff members after a confrontation with wide receiver Chris Stewart, amid the incidents that occurred following the Longhorns' nail-biting 22-21 victory at Tiger Stadium.
articles.summary: Mike the Tiger had to be restrained by staff members after a confrontation with wide receiver Chris Stewart, amid the incidents that occurred following the Longhorns' nail-biting 22-21 victory at Tiger Stadium.
articles.body:
LSU’s loss to Texas led to a scene that quickly drew attention in college football. After losing 22–21 in the final seconds, the Tigers’ mascot, Mike the Tiger , was involved in a tense confrontation with a Longhorns player and had to be restrained by staff members to prevent the situation from escalating.

The incident occurred Saturday night at Tiger Stadium as Texas players celebrated their victory in Baton Rouge. Footage released after the game shows Longhorns wide receiver Chris Stewart exchanging a few words with the LSU mascot. Mike’s reaction was immediate: he charged toward the player, and several people had to step in to separate them.

The LSU mascot had to be restrained following the altercation with Chris Stewart

The problem was recorded by Hunter McMann, a reporter for the local network WBRZ, and posted on social media. The video also shows other Texas players approaching the section of the stands occupied by LSU students to celebrate their victory and taunt the local fans.

In another part of the footage, Raleek Brown, who scored Texas’s game-winning touchdown, is seen exchanging words with LSU linebacker Jake Ibieta. Tensions escalated when Stewart walked past Mike the Tiger, leading to a confrontation that ended with the home team’s staff stepping in. It has not been publicly confirmed what the wide receiver said to the mascot before his reaction.

There was one notable detail about the scene: Mike the Tiger is not just the real tiger that represents the university and lives on campus. In this case, it was the person wearing the mascot costume, who regularly participates in games and events for the LSU athletic program. Therefore, there was no confrontation with the animal.

Texas staged a comeback in the final seconds and silenced Tiger Stadium

The incident occurred after a game that ended in the worst possible way for LSU. The Tigers held a 21-10 lead in the third quarter, but Texas managed to stage a comeback in the closing moments thanks to a final drive led by Arch Manning.

With just three seconds left on the clock, the quarterback found Raleek Brown with a four-yard touchdown pass. The extra point allowed the Longhorns to complete the comeback and secure a 22-21 victory in a stadium that had drawn a crowd of 102,321.

Manning finished the game with 174 passing yards, one touchdown, and three interceptions. On the other side, LSU quarterback Sam Leavitt also threw three interceptions. The loss left the Tigers with a 6-4 record, while Texas improved its record to 8-2 and kept its hopes alive for a spot in the college football playoffs.

Texas’ celebration and the confrontation between Stewart and Mike the Tiger ended up becoming some of the most talked-about moments of the night. For LSU, however, the home finale was particularly bitter: in addition to losing on the final play, their defeat was accompanied by an unusual scene that ended with their own mascot having to be restrained.

articles.title: Mahomes throws 5 TD passes and rookie Johnson runs for 101 yards as Chiefs overwhelm Falcons 35-13
articles.standfirst: The quarterback on Andy Reid's team lived up to his reputation
articles.summary: The quarterback on Andy Reid's team lived up to his reputation
articles.body:
ATLANTA (AP) — Patrick Mahomes threw five touchdown passes, including one to newly acquired Josh Downs and two to rookie Emmett Johnson, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the struggling Atlanta Falcons 35-13 on Sunday to move into a first-place tie in the AFC West.

The Chiefs (7-2) leaned on Johnson at running back after ruling out Kenneth Walker on Saturday because of a groin injury. Johnson had 22 carries for 101 yards and six catches for 70 yards and two touchdowns in his first start.

The Chiefs moved into a first-place tie with Denver, which had its bye week. Mahomes completed 22 of 35 passes for 348 yards to keep the depleted offense moving. Cyrus Allen and Andrew Armstrong each had his first career touchdown catch

Walker was not the only missing player on the Chiefs' offense. Tight end Travis Kelce aggravated a right ankle injury on a 23-yard catch on the Chiefs' opening touchdown drive. Kelce missed most of the first half and finished with two catches for 30 yards. Tight end Jared Wiley was ruled out with an ankle injury in the opening quarter and right guard Trey Smith (concussion) also left in the first half.

The Falcons (3-7) have lost three straight and five of six. Atlanta was held without a first down on its first four possessions. Kansas City led 28-3 before Bijan Robinson's 3-yard scoring run midway through the fourth quarter.

Robinson, the NFL rushing leader, ran for 71 yards on 16 carries. Michael Penix Jr. completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards and one interception. Cornerback Nohl Williams picked off a pass from Penix intended for Chris Blair in the end zone with 2:39 remaining.

Downs was acquired from Indianapolis on Tuesday and made an immediate impact. He had an 18-yard touchdown catch on a perfect pass from Mahomes late in the first half and finished with four receptions for 53 yards while also returning punts.

The Chiefs stopped the Falcons on fourth down at midfield in the third quarter. Mahomes' 39-yard touchdown pass to rookie Allen pushed the lead to 21-3. Walker entered the weekend as the league's No. 2 rusher, behind only Atlanta's Robinson. ​

Johnson and Nate Carter, who was promoted from the practice squad, were the Chiefs' only active running backs. The Falcons had three new starters after trading safety Jessie Bates III and center Ryan Neuzil before the deadline. Corey Levin moved up as the starting center. DeMarcco Hellams started at safety. Jake Moody, who was signed off Baltimore's practice squad on Wednesday when Nick Folk was cut, made a 28-yard field goal in the second quarter for Atlanta's only first-half points. Moody added a 38-yarder in the final quarter after a successful onside kick was recovered by Blair.

Chiefs: Kelce returned in the second quarter after being carted off the field. Running back Jaydn Ott (hamstring) was inactive, adding another blow to the depth at the position with Walker out. Falcons: Linebacker Divine Deablo (forearm) was inactive. Josh Woods was the fill-in starter.

articles.title: “Big truck, small penis”: Alleged hit-and-run victim brutally mocks Rex Ryan in 911 call
articles.standfirst: Alleged victim unleashes brutal insult as details of Nashville incident emerge
articles.summary: Alleged victim unleashes brutal insult as details of Nashville incident emerge
articles.body:
Former NFL head coach Rex Ryan has become the focal point of a furious tirade after audio emerged of a 911 call made by a man who alleges the ESPN analyst ran over his and his wife's feet in Nashville.

Attorney Michael Holland made the emergency call shortly after the reported November 5 incident, and he made his anger toward the former New York Jets coach very clear.

The recording captures Holland demanding police action while delivering a particularly brutal insult about Ryan's vehicle.

“I just got, literally, my wife and I both got ran over by some a**hole on f**king Broadway and I want to turn him in,” Holland said.

As he explained what had happened, Holland reportedly described following Ryan's truck and confronting the driver at a traffic light. He also provided authorities with the vehicle's registration details, including its distinctive New York vanity plate, which read "HIT QBS."

However, his description of the pickup attracted perhaps the most attention.

"A big red pickup with oversized wheels that said small penis," Holland told the dispatcher.

Holland continued expressing his frustration throughout the conversation, insisting that Ryan should be arrested and questioning whether he should be allowed behind the wheel.

Although he declined medical assistance at the scene, he admitted that his feet were hurting and warned that his toes would likely be in bad shape the following morning.

Ryan faces six misdemeanor charges following Nashville incident

The explosive phone call follows allegations that Ryan struck Holland and his wife while turning at an intersection on Broadway Street in downtown Nashville.

According to police, the couple had a pedestrian crossing signal when Ryan allegedly turned his pickup truck and drove over their feet, making contact with one person's leg. The driver reportedly continued along the road before being confronted by the pair at another red light.

Holland previously spoke to the New York Post about the frightening encounter, claiming that he and his wife could have suffered considerably worse injuries had they been standing further into the street.

He also shared details of their injuries, saying his wife had already lost a toenail while he expected to lose two himself. Both anticipated needing further medical attention, including X-rays.

Holland also alleged that he struck Ryan's vehicle window before the former coach got out and confronted the couple. Ryan allegedly returned to his truck and drove away rather than remaining at the scene or apologizing,

Police reportedly reviewed surveillance footage before issuing six misdemeanor warrants against Ryan . The charges include two counts each of leaving an accident scene, failing to provide information or render aid, and disobeying a traffic control signal.

Ryan surrendered to authorities on November 11 and was released on $6,000 bond. He's scheduled to appear in court on December 18.

Meanwhile, the controversy hasn't stopped his ESPN commitments. Ryan appeared on Sunday NFL Countdown on November 15, discussing football without addressing the allegations. He focused on the Detroit Lions-New England Patriots matchup instead.

The network previously confirmed it was aware of the situation and remained in contact with the analyst.

Ryan , who coached the Jets and Buffalo Bills before joining ESPN in 2017, has yet to publicly address the allegations.

articles.title: Dianna Russini’s guest opens up about the awkward fallout from joining her show amid the Mike Vrabel controversy
articles.standfirst: Months after the drama with the Patriots coach, the reporter began hosting a weekly show for BetUS
articles.summary: Months after the drama with the Patriots coach, the reporter began hosting a weekly show for BetUS
articles.body:
Seven months after a massive tabloid storm rocked the NFL media landscape during the 2026 offseason, prominent insider Dianna Russini is still struggling to shake off the lingering fallout.

Back in April, viral photos and videos surfaced showing Russini holding hands with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel at an Arizona resort, a revelation that sparked instant national scrutiny given that both figures were married at the time.

The scandal led directly to Russini’s resignation from The Athletic that same month, and despite more than 200 days passing since the initial leak, relentless jokes, edited clips, and viral memes continue to dominate sports social media feeds every single week.

Dianna Russini’s First Guest Opens Up About Awkward Show Fallout

Attempting to move past the controversy and relaunch her broadcasting career, Russini debuted her new weekly BetUS program , The Russini Report , alongside guests Bill Parcells , Spike Eskin , and longtime friend Damon Amendolara .

However, the premiere episode quickly took an uncomfortable turn when Amendolara, a veteran SiriusXM NFL Radio host , brought up the internet memes right at the top of the segment, referencing a viral Tiny Desk parody featuring Vrabel, Patriots players, and Russini playing the saxophone.

Russini visibly bristled at the reminder of the scandal she is desperately trying to put behind her, calling the ongoing meme cycle “miserable” before tersely telling viewers, “There are a lot of funny people out there. So, I hope you all have had your laughs.”

Following the tense broadcast, Amendolara revealed that his decision to appear on the premiere triggered an immediate and brutal wave of online backlash. Speaking candidly about the aftermath of the Wednesday episode, he described his social media mentions as a “ horror show ” filled with harsh attacks directed at both Russini and himself simply for associating with her platform.

Amendolara clarified that bringing up the jokes was never meant to mock her personal or family life , explaining that he only wanted to inject humor as a supportive friend who has known her since her local reporting days in Washington, D.C., around 2013 .

Now, as The Russini Report prepares to air its second episode today, November 18, with an unannounced guest list, it remains clear that escaping the shadow of the Mike Vrabel controversy will require far more than a fresh studio set and a new network home.

articles.title: Ryan Clark exposes truth about Tony Romo's CBS departure: “He was forced out”
articles.standfirst: Circumstances surrounding Romo's departure under the spotlight
articles.summary: Circumstances surrounding Romo's departure under the spotlight
articles.body:
Tony Romo 's departure from CBS may have followed his arrest in Wisconsin, but Ryan Clark believes the former Dallas Cowboys quarterback had already lost the network's confidence due to his declining performances in the broadcast booth.

Romo was once regarded as one of the most exciting additions to NFL television, earning widespread praise after joining CBS in 2017. His ability to anticipate plays before they developed quickly established him as a distinctive voice alongside Jim Nantz .

However, that early enthusiasm gradually gave way to criticism over his commentary, preparation and consistency, leaving questions about whether CBS would have retained him if his broadcasting reputation had remained as strong as it was during his first two seasons.

Speaking to Front Office Sports, Clark argued that Romo 's professional standing had deteriorated before his legal troubles accelerated the end of his relationship with the network.

“I’m gonna say it, people might get mad at me. If he was still the Tony Romo from the first two years, Tony Romo still has a job,” Clark said.

“I feel like Tony Romo was forced out because of some of the negative fodder you get about what he’s doing during games. So I hope he comes back and gets a chance to do it.”

New details emerge about Romo departure

CBS announced that it had mutually agreed to part ways with Romo on October 2, approximately two months after placing him on indefinite leave following his July arrest.

The former quarterback was stopped by authorities in Milwaukee on July 23 and subsequently pleaded no contest to operating a vehicle while intoxicated in September.

His departure ended a lucrative broadcasting agreement that reportedly had four years and approximately $72 million remaining, raising questions about why CBS was prepared to move on from such a significant investment.

The Athletic reported that the network had grown frustrated with Romo 's preparation and reliability, suggesting his arrest provided an opportunity to make a change that executives had already been considering.

Those claims support Clark 's interpretation, although CBS hasn't publicly confirmed that concerns about Romo 's commentary were responsible for ending his contract.

J.J. Watt secures CBS role

CBS has already committed to a different direction, with former Houston Texans defensive star J.J. Watt becoming Nantz 's permanent broadcasting partner after initially replacing Romo during his suspension.

Watt subsequently signed a multiyear extension, effectively closing the door on an immediate return to CBS for the former Cowboys quarterback.

Nevertheless, Clark believes Romo could rediscover the qualities that made him such a successful analyst at the beginning of his TV career.

“I believe Tony Romo deserves another chance to be in the booth, and I also think that he would tap back in more so than he did toward the latter part of his [TV] career,” Clark said.

Romo has since made a brief television appearance on ESPN2, although he's yet to announce a permanent broadcasting position.

Whether another major network offers him an opportunity remains uncertain, but Clark 's assessment suggests rebuilding his professional reputation could prove just as important.

Romo has since made a brief television appearance on ESPN2, although he's yet to announce a permanent broadcasting position.
Whether another major network offers him an opportunity remains uncertain, but Clark 's assessment suggests rebuilding his professional reputation could prove just as important.

articles.title: What NFL Teams have a Bye Week 11? Everyone who's out for this week
articles.standfirst: Six franchises, including four teams locked in tight playoff races, head to the sidelines during the 2026 NFL season’s heaviest bye week
articles.summary: Six franchises, including four teams locked in tight playoff races, head to the sidelines during the 2026 NFL season’s heaviest bye week
articles.body:
Every autumn, NFL fans and fantasy football managers brace for the busiest break on the regular-season calendar, and in 2026 that crunch arrives in Week 11.

Six teams are off from November 19 through November 23: the Atlanta Falcons , Cleveland Browns , Green Bay Packers , Los Angeles Rams , New England Patriots , and Seattle Seahawks .

Across the 18-week, 17-game regular season, the league distributes single-week breaks between Week 5 and Week 14. While no teams are idle in Weeks 1 through 4, Week 12, or Weeks 15 through 18, Week 11 carries the largest group of resting franchises of any slate on the 2026 schedule.

As NFL.com noted when the schedule dropped, players often offer standard clichés, such as “We're ready for anyone, anywhere, any time”, when asked about upcoming opponents, yet the timing of a midseason breather remains one of the biggest factors in keeping a roster healthy for December.

With six clubs resting, 26 teams remain active across 13 matchups. The slate kicks off Thursday night, November 19, when the Indianapolis Colts visit the Houston Texans, features an international Sunday night showcase between the Minnesota Vikings and San Francisco 49ers at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, and wraps up on Monday Night Football with the Cincinnati Bengals visiting the Washington Commanders .

Week 11 Bye Dates: November 19–23, 2026

- Total Teams on Bye: 6 teams (26 teams active across 13 matchups)

Teams on Bye & Notable Players Out

- Atlanta Falcons (NFC South | 3–7)

- Notable players out: Bijan Robinson, Drake London, Kyle Pitts Sr., Michael Penix Jr.

- Week 12 opponent: at Carolina Panthers

- Cleveland Browns (AFC North | 6–4)

- Notable players out: Deshaun Watson, Quinshon Judkins, Jerry Jeudy, Harold Fannin Jr., Denzel Ward

- Week 12 opponent: vs. Las Vegas Raiders

- Green Bay Packers (NFC North | 6–4)

- Notable players out: Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Matthew Golden, Tucker Kraft, Kaleb Johnson, Josh Jacobs (injured), Micah Parsons (injured)

- Week 12 opponent: at Los Angeles Rams (Wednesday, November 25)

- Los Angeles Rams (NFC West | 6–4)

- Notable players out: Matthew Stafford, Puka Nacua, Davante Adams, Kyren Williams, Blake Corum

- Week 12 opponent: vs. Green Bay Packers (Wednesday, November 25)

- New England Patriots (AFC East | 5–5)

- Notable players out: A.J. Brown, Rhamondre Stevenson, Hunter Henry, Christian Gonzalez, Drake Maye (injured)

- Week 12 opponent: at Los Angeles Chargers

- Seattle Seahawks (NFC West | 6–4)

- Notable players out: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Cooper Kupp, Jadarian Price, Sam Darnold (injured)

- Week 12 opponent: vs. San Francisco 49ers

Playoff contenders and fantasy stars sidelined across all six idle rosters

For fantasy managers and postseason watchers alike, the Week 11 “Byepocalypse” removes a massive wave of top-tier talent from action.

Four of the six idle teams, Cleveland, Green Bay, Los Angeles, and Seattle, enter the weekend sitting at 6-4 and squarely in the thick of their respective conference playoff pictures.

In the NFC West, both the Los Angeles Rams and Seattle Seahawks take a simultaneous pause after contrasting Week 10 victories. Los Angeles rides a four-game winning streak following a 34-6 rout of Arizona, giving veteran quarterback Matthew Stafford , dynamic wideouts Puka Nacua and Davante Adams , and running backs Kyren Williams and Blake Corum a welcome rest.

Seattle, meanwhile, comes off a 21-13 road win over Las Vegas, putting wide receivers Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Cooper Kupp alongside rookie running back Jadarian Price on pause while injured quarterback Sam Darnold continues his recovery.

In the NFC North, the Green Bay Packers use their week off to regroup after a 30-10 division loss to Minnesota.

Quarterback Jordan Love , receivers Christian Watson and Matthew Golden , tight end Tucker Kraft , and rookie running back Kaleb Johnson are all idle, while running back Josh Jacobs (fractured finger) and pass-rusher Micah Parsons gain valuable rehabilitation time.

Notably, both Green Bay and Los Angeles face a compressed turnaround coming out of the break, as they meet head-to-head at SoFi Stadium on Wednesday, November 25, in the NFL’s inaugural Thanksgiving Eve broadcast.

Over in the AFC, the Cleveland Browns rest Deshaun Watson , rookie back Quinshon Judkins , wideout Jerry Jeudy , tight end Harold Fannin Jr., and shutdown corner Denzel Ward after edging Houston 27-24.

The New England Patriots (5-5) return from their trip to Munich, where they fell 35-10 to Detroit, to sideline wide receiver A.J. Brown, running back Rhamondre Stevenson, tight end Hunter Henry, and cornerback Christian Gonzalez while evaluating quarterback Drake Maye’s injury outlook.

Rounding out the group, the Atlanta Falcons (3-7) give offensive stars Bijan Robinson, Drake London, Kyle Pitts Sr. , and quarterback Michael Penix Jr. a reset following a 35-13 setback against Kansas City.

Because no teams are scheduled for a bye in Week 12, all 32 NFL clubs, and every star player currently resting, will be back on the field next week.

articles.title: Dianna Russini can’t catch a break over another awkward moment on her NFL show
articles.standfirst: Viewers questioned Russini’s microphone during her interview with Drew Rosenhaus, a week after technical problems delayed the debut of her BetUS program
articles.summary: Viewers questioned Russini’s microphone during her interview with Drew Rosenhaus, a week after technical problems delayed the debut of her BetUS program
articles.body:
Dianna Russini’s second episode of The Russini Report had a new distraction: viewers questioned the sound of her microphone during an interview with NFL agent Drew Rosenhaus . Some suggested it was not plugged in or that the wrong audio input had been selected.

The moment followed a rocky start for the show. Its Nov. 11 premiere was delayed after BetUS’s website ran into technical problems ; the show’s account attributed the delay to a record audience. Rosenhaus appeared on the second episode, which aired Nov. 18.

During the interview, Russini and Rosenhaus discussed Brandon Aiyuk’s uncertain NFL future. Viewers commented that Rosenhaus sounded clearer than Russini and asked her to check the microphone settings. Anticipation for Dianna’s return to the media was high, but the moment fell short of expectations. The audio drew more attention than the interview or her comeback itself.

The production hiccup also comes as Russini returns to NFL coverage after leaving The Athletic in April. Her resignation followed published photos of her with New England Patriots coach Mike Vrabel and an internal review by the publication.

The contrast in their public and professional fallout is hard to ignore. Russini resigned from The Athletic after the outlet investigated whether her relationship with Vrabel violated its standards; she later returned to NFL coverage through a weekly show on BetUS.

Mike Vrabel, meanwhile, stayed on as Patriots coach. He said he had difficult conversations with his family and the team, and stepped away briefly to seek counseling before returning to work.

The situations were not identical. Dianna Russini’s employer was examining a potential conflict of interest in her reporting, but the difference in how their careers unfolded still invites questions about whose reputation takes the bigger hit when a controversy involves a man and a woman.

The latest episode was supposed to put her back in the NFL conversation, but viewers focused on the audio instead. And while the controversy with Vrabel has faded from the show’s immediate conversation, the gap between their professional consequences remains part of the story of her return.

There was also news in the conversation. Rosenhaus said Aiyuk was healthy, working out and ready to return to football. He said he and the receiver had not seriously discussed a return to San Francisco because they were unsure the 49ers would welcome him back. Those were the agent’s claims about his client’s condition and prospects.

Aiyuk’s situation remains unsettled. The NFL reinstated him and gave San Francisco a two-week roster exemption, with a decision on his roster status expected by Nov. 23.

The 49ers had previously said their relationship with the receiver was over , while Rosenhaus said he expected other teams could be interested if Aiyuk became available.

articles.title: NFL Week 11 2026: Schedule and where to watch all the weekend's games
articles.standfirst: The 49ers and Vikings close out a day of sudden death for those chasing the playoffs.
articles.summary: The 49ers and Vikings close out a day of sudden death for those chasing the playoffs.
articles.body:
The 2026-2027 NFL season reaches Week 11 with the schedule divided into two very different realities. On one hand, a group of eight teams tied with a 7-2 record are battling for every seeding position; on the other, a handful of struggling franchises are playing for pride.

It's one of those days where a single defeat can send a contender from second place to the wild card, and where the bottom spots in both conferences continue fighting to get out of the basement.

The main event arrives Monday night: the NFC-leading San Francisco 49ers, with an 8-1 record, host the 7-2 Minnesota Vikings, who are tied for first place in the NFC North. But before that, there's plenty of football to enjoy, with heated divisional rivalries throughout Sunday.

Week 11 Overview: Where to watch NFL games

Indianapolis Colts @ Houston Texans

Time: 8:15 pm Eastern Time (7:15 pm CET and 5:15 pm PT)

Where to watch: Amazon Prime Video

Buffalo Bills @ Miami Dolphis

Time: 1:00 pm ET (12:00 pm CET and 10:00 am PT)

New Orleans Saints @ Chicago Bears

Carolina Panthers @ Baltimore Ravens

Venue: Bank of America Stadium

Tampa Bay Buccaneers @ Detroit Lions

Arizona Cardinals @ Kansas City Chiefs

Pittsburgh Steelers @ Philadelphia Eagles

Venue: Lincoln Financial Field

New York Jets @ Los Angeles Chargers

Time: 4:05 pm Eastern Time (3:05 pm CET and 1:05 pm PT)

Las Vegas Raiders @ Denver Broncos

Time: 4:25 pm Eastern Time (3:25 pm CET and 1:25 pm PT)

Venue: Empower Field at Mile High

Jacksonville Jaguars @ New York Giants

San Francisco 49ers @ receive Minnesota Vikings

Time: 8:20 pm Eastern Time (7:20 pm CET and 5:20 pm PT)

Venue: Banorte Stadium, Mexico City

Cincinnati Bengals @ Washington Commanders

Star matchup: 49ers vs Vikings in Mexico City

Sunday Night Football pits the only two NFC teams with just one loss against each other at the top of the conference… well, San Francisco (8-1) leads the NFC West with authority, while Minnesota ( 7-2) shares the top spot in the NFC North with Detroit and Chicago, all with identical records. On paper, it's a potential preview of January.

San Francisco arrives with a weapon-laden offense: quarterback Brock Purdy has Christian McCaffrey in the backfield , star tight end George Kittle, and a receiving corps featuring heavyweights like Deebo Samuel Sr., Brandon Aiyuk, Mike Evans, and Keenan Allen. With 281 points scored, the 49ers are one of the most potent scoring machines in the league.

On the other side, the Vikings boast the best defense in the NFC: just 126 points allowed in nine games, the best record in the conference. Offensively, veteran Kirk Cousins pulls the strings with the ever-present threat of Justin Jefferson, backed up by Jordan Addison, Aaron Jones Sr. on the ground, and tight end TJ Hockenson.

Implications for the fight for the top spot in the NFL and the battle to avoid the bottom

The competition at the top of the standings is brutal. Eight teams share a 7-2 record: Denver, Jacksonville, Minnesota, Detroit, Chicago, Cincinnati, and Kansas City, just behind the two 8-1 leaders (Buffalo and San Francisco). On a day like this, tiebreakers are worth their weight in gold.

In the AFC, Buffalo (8-1) can extend its lead over the Dolphins, while Jacksonville — leader of the AFC South and owner of the best differential in the league (+125) — tests its candidacy in New York against the Giants.

Denver and Kansas City, tied at the top of the AFC West, cannot afford to slip up: the Broncos host Las Vegas and the Chiefs host Arizona, both on paper favorable.

In the NFC, the three-way tie in the North (Detroit, Minnesota, Chicago) means that each result reconfigures the seeding; Detroit and Chicago play at home against rivals from the NFC South, and Minnesota closes out the day on Monday.

The picture below is stark. In the AFC, the Los Angeles Chargers (1-8), Miami Dolphins (1-8), and Tennessee Titans (1-8) share the bottom spot. The Jets (2-8) vs. Chargers (1-8) game is, quite literally, a battle to avoid being the worst team in the conference. The Dolphins, moreover, visit the toughest possible opponent in Buffalo, and the Titans host Dallas looking for their second win.

In the NFC, the Philadelphia Eagles (2-7) are at the bottom of the standings and host a hot Steelers team (6-3): a Herculean task. Arizona (3-7) and Atlanta, also in the bottom half of the standings, are still looking more towards the draft than the playoffs.

What are the predictions for the main games of Week 11 of the NFL?

On Sunday Night, the clash of styles slightly favors San Francisco: their offensive output (281 points scored) should generate enough points to overcome Minnesota's resistance, although the Vikings' defense (126 against, the best in the NFC) promises a closer score than the 8-1 home record suggests.

In the rest of the games, Buffalo, Denver and Kansas City are clear favorites at home, and Jacksonville has what it takes to upset the Giants in New York.

articles.title: Troy Aikman airs grievances with brutal ‘one-man booth’ joke aimed at Joe Buck
articles.standfirst: Aikman's latest radio appearance has reignited speculation about relationship with Buck
articles.summary: Aikman's latest radio appearance has reignited speculation about relationship with Buck
articles.body:
A seemingly harmless conversation about an absent radio host has provided Troy Aikman with another opportunity to take a swipe at Joe Buck , as questions continue to surround one of the NFL 's longest-running broadcasting partnerships.

The former Dallas Cowboys quarterback appeared on Dallas radio station 96.7 The Ticket on Thursday, where he was speaking with The Musers host George Dunham during his regular weekly appearance.

With Dunham 's usual co-host Craig Miller absent through illness, Aikman noticed the unusual arrangement and quickly turned the conversation toward his own broadcasting situation at ESPN.

When Dunham jokingly invited him to join the show, Aikman responded with a remark that appeared to reference the reported friction between himself and Buck .

"Well, I know Joe’s always wanted a one-man booth; I’m wondering if you’ve always wanted a one-man radio show?" Aikman said.

Dunham laughed at the joke, but its significance was difficult to ignore given the situation surrounding the future of ESPN's Monday Night Football commentary team.

Aikman and Buck have worked together for more than two decades, developing their partnership at Fox before moving to ESPN in 2022.

However, their relationship has reportedly become strained over the 2026 NFL season, with their contrasting contract situations attracting considerable attention.

Buck reportedly agreed to a six-year extension worth $108 million in September, securing his future with the network while Aikman remains in the final year of his current agreement.

The uncertainty became more prominent following reports of an argument between the pair before a Bills-Rams game earlier this season.

According to journalist Andrew Marchand, Buck confronted Aikman during an exchange that included frustration over the former quarterback's contract situation.

"You are not going to f**king talk to me?" Buck reportedly said. "I'm not the reason you don't have a contract."

Aikman didn't directly address the reported claims when questioned in October, although he did acknowledge that his broadcasting future remained unresolved.

"There's probably a time and a place for all that. I don't know if now is the time," Aikman said.

ESPN faces questions about Aikman

The three-time Super Bowl champion has made no commitment to remaining with ESPN beyond the current season, leaving open the possibility that his partnership with Buck could end.

"I'll broadcast through this season and I'll be a free agent at the end of the year and kind of see what happens," Aikman explained in October.

"I'm looking forward to whatever the rest of this season does hold and the Super Bowl and all that and where my next landing spot may be."

ESPN chairman Jimmy Pitaro has expressed disappointment with the attention surrounding the reported dispute, although the network hasn't announced any changes to its broadcasting plans.

Aikman also made a lighthearted reference to Buck 's appearance at Wednesday's CMA Awards during his radio interview, describing his colleague as "ubiquitous."

The latest comments may have been intended as friendly teasing, but they arrive against a backdrop of unresolved negotiations and reports of genuine tension.

With ESPN preparing to broadcast the Super Bowl in February, the network faces increasing scrutiny over whether its established commentary partnership will survive beyond the championship game.

The podcast host has built a reputation for speaking openly about her life , marriage and family, but that doesn't mean she's willing to answer every question that comes her way . Her latest interaction with a fan showed just how quickly she can push back when a conversation gets too personal.

During the November 19 episode of her podcast, Not Gonna Lie , Kylie brought back her fan-question segment, now called "Ask Me Some Things." One submission, however, immediately caught her attention a fter shifting the conversation toward a private aspect of her marriage to former Philadelphia Eagles star Jason Kelce.

Kylie Kelce makes it clear that some questions go too far

The fan's message focused on Jason's physical appearance and football background before asking Kylie how the couple kept their bedroom life exciting. The question prompted an audible reaction from the 34-year-old, who expressed disbelief that someone would feel comfortable asking her about such an intimate subject.

Kylie also explained that the segment's name change was intentional. What was previously presented as an open invitation for fans to ask anything had been narrowed down to reflect the kind of questions she was actually willing to entertain, particularly after receiving submissions she considered inappropriate.

Jason Kelce's wife has pushed back against fans before

This isn't the first time Kylie has confronted people online over comments involving her husband . Last year, she addressed followers who left suggestive reactions on Jason's social media posts, making it clear that there was a difference between appreciating his appearance and crossing personal boundaries.

At the time, she acknowledged that she understood the attention Jason received, but reminded fans that he was her husband and the father of their children.

Her willingness to speak up has also extended beyond her relationship. In September, Kylie responded to criticism about the condition of her family minivan, while the following month she defended her decision to own the properties surrounding their home, e xplaining that privacy and security were important considerations. The latest exchange on Not Gonna Lie adds another example of Kylie setting boundaries with her audience, showing that being a public figure doesn't mean every part of her marriage or family life is open for discussion.
